system.description:
You set a hidden ward that springs to life the instant it's needed. The next time a creature hits you with an attack or targets you with a spell before this ends, the trap triggers: the triggering creature takes damage and, if it hasn't yet resolved its own effect, that effect fails.

Scaling: At dice count 3, the damage increases substantially. At dice count 6, the trap can trigger twice before it's spent. At dice count 9, the duration increases to 8 hours. At dice count 12, triggering the trap also grants you advantage on your next attack against the triggering creature. At dice count 15, the trap protects every ally within 5 feet of you as well.
